statement: Goblin Gorfest is the level 1 totem for Worship located in World 1 Forest Outskirts
Totem gives Forest Souls when you spend Worship Charge or complete Tower Defense waves
Spec into Stop Right There talent which immobilizes nearby monsters; higher level gives longer root
Spec into 360 NoScope talent because it can hit multiple enemies
Damage in Tower Defense is capped at 1 per attack so don't worry much about damage stat
Take Kung Fu Kick in tab 2; it pushes back nearby monsters and higher level pushes farther
Knockback is helpful for keeping mobs near your towers longer
Level Piercing Arrow enough to hit all 4 monsters since it hits multiple enemies
This is only one of many effective builds; there are many other ways to place towers
Click the totem then press Summon Button to start Tower Defense and menus pop up
First towers to summon are Fireball Towers and Frost Towers
In early waves you may need to shoot some enemies yourself; don't worry about it too much
With spare points place a few more fireball towers at the bottom to catch anything that gets past
You can start upgrading towers if needed while waiting for points
Damage is distributed better with more towers early game
Next priority is getting Party Towers out
Early boss is a mini-boss; the real Boss Waves are on Wave 10
Place first Party Tower in the spot shown; its circle shows range and it helps placement of the next tower
Party Tower does nothing until level 5 so level it ASAP
Don't spend points on Party Tower if you won't take it to level 5
Choose trait Other towers in range get more speed for Party Tower; the other trait is not working currently
Party Tower trait gives all towers more attack speed so monsters die much quicker
Next priority is Kraken Tower which keeps enemies under towers longer
Place 2 more Fireball Towers at the bottom
Upgrading top towers priority is Fireball Towers first
On Fireball Towers always take Trait B 20% bigger explosion radius first then Trait A
On Frozone Towers always take Trait B and never Trait A as it's not worth it
Place last towers as Party Towers: one up top and two on the bottom
This setup should get you to at least Wave 60
Finally add more Party Towers and upgrade all towers to level 10
Party Tower attack speed bonus stacks multiple times and can bring towers down to half a second attack speed
Later waves are overwhelming so keep upgrading towers especially primary attackers and Party Towers for damage and attack speed
Use Roots and Knockbacks as often as possible to keep monsters in tower range longer
